name: Juehuaornis
sum: Ornithuromorph from near Lingyuan, Liaoning, with a beak reaching 70 percent of the skull length.
biology: Not given in the sources used beyond its long beak.
author: Wang et al. 2015

sources.text:
R.-F. Wang, Y. Wang, and D. Y. Hu. 2015. Discovery of a new ornithuromorph genus, Juehuaornis gen. nov.
from Lower Cretaceous of western Liaoning, China. Global Geology 34(1):7-11

Huang, J.; Wang, X.; Hu, Y.; Liu, J.; Peteya, J.A.; Clarke, J.A. 2016. A new ornithurine from the Early Cretaceous of China sheds light on the evolution of early ecological and cranial diversity in birds. PeerJ 4. doi:10.7717/peerj.1765
